name: network-outage
description: Core switch loses power mid-event; badge readers and Wi-Fi fail across two sectors. Nobody is hurt.

ticks.narrative: 14:05 Facilities radio: breaker tripped in the server_closet, core switch and PoE injectors are dark. Wi-Fi is down across main_stage and workshop_room and the badge readers on both doors stopped responding; doors have failed open. Roughly 60 attendees are mid-session in main_stage and 25 in workshop_room. No smoke, no smell, HVAC and lighting normal. Server closet temperature reading 31C and rising with the exhaust fan off. Facilities lead is three minutes out.
